info.title: RunSignal CLI: provision alerts for background jobs from a workload manifest
info.description: The runsignal command: plan, diff and provision New Relic alerts, or export Prometheus alerting rules (missed, overrun, stalled, low-output and failure-rate), for the background jobs listed in RunSignal workload manifests. Idempotent and safe to run in CI.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: RunSignal: alerts for background work that no HTTP status code describes.

options.description: Show help and usage information

options.description: Show version information

commands.name: plan
commands.description: Show the alerts the manifests produce, without contacting New Relic.

options.name: --missed-grace
options.description: Minutes a scheduled workload may run late before it counts as missed, when it has no max duration. [default: 15]

options.name: --not-reporting-after
options.description: Minutes without any signal before an incident opens because the service stopped reporting. [default: 15]

options.name: --time-zone
options.description: Time zone the cron schedules run in, such as Europe/Istanbul. [default: UTC]

arguments.name: MANIFESTS
arguments.description: One or more workload manifests written by the RunSignal SDK (RUNSIGNAL_MANIFEST_PATH).
